description: Reply in-thread to a message. Pass the message_id to reply to and the body (plain text) and/or html_body; from_name, reply_to and attachments are optional. The reply goes to the original's Reply-To, else its From. Returns the reply's id and who it went to.

agent_id.description: accountId from list_agents. One credential directory holds one inbox, so omit it; another inbox's id is refused.

attachments.description: Files to attach, each as a local path or inline base64.

data_base64.description: File bytes as base64, instead of path.

filename.description: Attachment filename (default: basename of path; required with data_base64).

path.description: Readable file path on the MCP host (absolute or relative to cwd).

credentials_dir.description: Credential directory for this call (default: ATOMIC_MAIL_CREDENTIALS_DIR or ~/.atomicmail). Use separate paths per account; see help topic multi_account.

from_name.description: Display name on the From header, e.g. Anna from Acme. The address is always this inbox's.

html_body.description: HTML version of the message. The recipient's mail app shows it instead of body; without body the plain-text part is derived from it.

message_id.description: The Email id to reply to.

reply_to.description: Address(es) replies should go to, when not this inbox. Never a recipient's own address: outbound spam filtering blocks that.

name: reply_to_message
title: Reply to a message
